metadata.explanation: Wait for an admitted Live removal or deletion command; both start by removing Live serving.
Clear the Project's Live pointer once Live serving and its grant are gone.
Advance the active command to its next phase, or complete it.
Prove cleanup membership empty and atomically complete project deletion.
Destroy the Live project infrastructure and delete the Project's stored objects, waiting until both are gone.
Retain a failed command phase and its safe Failure until the command is retried.
Record a Session start whose retries ran out; the Project stays READY, and the Session's admission clears the failure.
Retain an uncertain Setup start without preventing Project deletion.
Record the TeamSpace's refusal or an unconfirmed registration, and end the Project, which created nothing yet.
Register the Project in its TeamSpace before any effect, as its creator.
Delete the Project's connection usages and scope tokens, so its applications read no credential.
End the archived managed repository's exclusive binding, which completes the binding's Flow.
Remove the Live serving resources and wait until they are gone.
Revoke the Live deployment's workload grant and wait until revocation completes.
Start the READY Project's one Session; a retried or replayed start joins its execution.
Start Setup from accepted Project identity before entering command waits.
Clean up and acknowledge registered children in rotating batches until membership is empty.
